review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved both boolean flags, empty fields, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise, vivid modern Greek, correct agreement and item gender, and consistent Skeleton and Castle Village glossary terminology.
